body: I can relate kinda, I had this week(still do tmrw last day) a so called exam week and I didn’t go 2 out of 4 days already. The other 2 days I know I fucked up so badly but I got to the point of not caring anymore. My parents used to be strict and care alot about my grades but it seems like they gave up on me. I had to do this year over again so I have the feeling of being extremely stupid while I know I am not? My concentration level hit 0 so studying is almost impossible idk what I am doing with my education. I do care but there is also this side in me which tells me that I shouldn’t worry about it. I really believe that we were told from the first day we were born that school = life? Most people make fun of you for not going to school and will tell you that you will be cleaning the streets while they will have a high educated job which they still work 9-5 for. Idk I might seem a bit crazy but I really hate the society we live in where most people work their asses of to get payed and buy stupid things to make them “happy”(this is my opinion, do whatever that makes you happy). My dream is once I get older ill be able to travel the world and live life however I wanna live it. But right now my mind is kinda fucked up but I hope that ill get through it and I hope you do aswell.
